en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside landscape with a narrow footpath bordered by wildflowers running along a grassy bank. Large trees dominate the left side, overhanging a wide river that curves into the distance with forested banks and low cliffs on the far side. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in a Baltic language, and there is a small publisher's logo on the lower right.
